name: stock-analyzer-ai
description: Analyze stocks with financial ratios, comparisons, and sector performance data.

tools.name: analyze_stock
tools.description: Analyze a stock with key metrics and generate a buy/hold/sell recommendation.

tools.name: calculate_ratios
tools.description: Calculate key financial ratios: P/E, P/B, P/S, dividend yield, debt-to-equity, and more.

tools.name: compare_stocks
tools.description: Compare multiple stocks side by side. Each item needs 'ticker', 'price', 'pe', and optionally 'growth', 'dividend_yield'.

tools.name: get_sector_performance
tools.description: Get sector performance data and representative tickers. Leave sector empty for all sectors.
